title: valeriana olitoria
intro: Valeriana olitoria, commonly known as Wild Valerian or Fragrant Valerian, is a perennial herbaceous plant that belongs to the Valerianaceae family. It is valued for its medicinal properties, offering a range of health benefits, including anxiety relief, improved sleep quality, and reduced inflammation. The therapeutic actions of Valeriana olitoria include sedative, anxiolytic, and anti-inflammatory effects, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents, such as valepotriates, valerenic acid, and isovaleric acid. These compounds are responsible for the plant's ability to promote relaxation, reduce stress, and alleviate symptoms of insomnia and restlessness.
